rationale: After breaking out to a new high of $17.68, the stock failed to sustain momentum and pulled back below both the entry price ($17.52) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($17.54). With the immediate continuation thesis invalidated by the loss of short-term moving average support, exiting now preserves the remaining daily loss budget rather than waiting for the hard stop at $17.38. Flipping to short is unwarranted given the 6.64x relative volume uptrend and price remaining well above the $16.95 session VWAP.
